families.name: fractureiser
families.description: Worm from 2023 that spread through infected CurseForge/Bukkit projects, infected mods/plugins on the PC, stole browser/Discord/Minecraft data and set up persistence.

families.name: SilentNet
families.description: SilentNet (silentnet.st) is a Minecraft RAT kit. Its loader gets injected into real mods, steals the Minecraft session token, fetches its server address from a blockchain (Polygon), downloads a hidden Python runtime and starts a stealer in the background.
